page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor built on the x86_64 architecture, delivering 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The CPU operates at a base speed of 2.7 GHz and is supported by 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.g7.4xlarge consistently in the average performance tier. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1889.28 and a multi-core score of 15481.55. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small-block cached bandwidth of 835.37 GB/sec, which drops to 94.57 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Cryptographic and vector processing capabilities are supported by hardware flags including AVX-512 and AES, reflected in a Passmark CPU encryption score of 14585.17.

This instance is designed for balanced workloads that require steady CPU and memory resources without specialized acceleration. It performs reliably for database operations, scoring 7892.12 on Passmark database benchmarks, and handles Redis SET operations at 15.62 million operations per second. While it handles small-scale language model inference efficiently, processing 1294.06 tokens per second for a 135M model prompt, its performance drops significantly to a weak 31.85 tokens per second for a 7B model prompt. This makes it suitable for web serving, application hosting, and moderate database workloads, but less optimal for large-scale AI or heavy storage-bound tasks due to the lack of local NVMe drives.
